record.paper_title: Open questions in quarkonium and electromagnetic probes
record.context_brief: Elementary-collision baseline versus claimed vector-meson modifications
record.original_question: How can the standard baseline understanding of low-mass dilepton production in elementary collisions be reconciled with the E325 claim that the properties of the ρ, ω, and φ mesons already undergo nuclear-matter modifications in 12 GeV proton-copper collisions?

evidence.quote: And how can we conciliate our basic understanding of low mass dilepton production in "elementary" collisions with E325’s claim [19] that there are already "nuclear matter modifications" of the properties of the ρ, ω and φ mesons produced in p-Cu collisions at 12 GeV?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
In proton–nucleus collisions at moderate energies, the dilepton invariant-mass spectrum in the low-mass region (roughly below 1.1 GeV/c²) is conventionally described by a "hadronic cocktail" of contributions from light-meson Dalitz decays and the direct dileptonic decays of the vector mesons ρ, ω, and φ, with their vacuum masses, widths, and branching ratios as measured in elementary (e.g. e+e−) reactions. In the KEK-PS E325 experiment, e+e− invariant-mass spectra produced in 12 GeV proton–copper collisions were measured and a significant excess on the low-mass side of the ω and φ peaks was reported, which the experiment interprets as in-medium modifications (mass shifts and/or broadening) of the ρ, ω, and φ mesons inside ordinary nuclear matter at normal density ρ₀.

Formulate and address the following question: assuming the standard vacuum-based "elementary-collision baseline" for ρ, ω, and φ production and decay into dileptons, identify a consistent theoretical and phenomenological framework that simultaneously
(i) reproduces dilepton spectra in elementary p+p (and p+d) reactions with vacuum vector-meson properties,
(ii) accounts quantitatively for the low-mass excess and the βγ (velocity) and target-mass (C vs. Cu) dependences observed by E325 in 12 GeV p+A collisions, and
(iii) is compatible with results from other experiments probing in-medium vector mesons (e.g. CLAS/g7, CBELSA/TAPS, HADES) which have not confirmed comparable mass shifts at normal nuclear density.

Specifically, determine whether the E325 excess can be explained without invoking a density-dependent shift of the pole masses of ρ, ω, φ — for instance by collisional broadening, coupled-channel effects, final-state interactions, or modifications of production amplitudes inside the nucleus — or whether a genuine in-medium pole-mass modification at normal nuclear density is required.
artifact.status_search_result: The tension persists. Recent analyses (2024–2025) revisit the KEK-PS E325 data, including an updated study of the velocity dependence of ρ and ω mass modifications and transport-approach analyses of φ-meson spectral modifications in 12 GeV p+A reactions. These works continue to interpret the observed low-mass excess in terms of in-medium modifications, while other experiments (CLAS, CBELSA/TAPS, HADES) have not corroborated comparable pole-mass shifts at normal nuclear density. No consensus theoretical reconciliation with the elementary-collision baseline has been established.

status_evidence.title: Velocity dependence of the mass modifications of ρ and ω mesons in 12 GeV p+A reactions
status_evidence.snippet: Updated analysis of KEK-PS E325 data presenting βγ-dependent mass modifications of ρ and ω mesons in 12 GeV p+A reactions.
status_evidence.claim: E325 results continue to be analyzed and reported as evidence for in-medium mass modification, indicating the question remains active.

status_evidence.title: Production and in-medium modification of φ mesons in proton-nucleus reactions from a transport approach
status_evidence.snippet: Transport-approach analysis of φ-meson spectral modifications relevant to the 12 GeV p+A E325 measurements.
status_evidence.claim: Theoretical reconciliation between elementary baselines and E325 φ-meson observations is still being investigated.

status_evidence.title: Experimental Signature of Medium Modifications for ρ and ω Mesons in the 12 GeV p+A Reactions
status_evidence.snippet: Original E325 publication reporting low-mass excess attributed to in-medium ρ and ω modifications in p+Cu at 12 GeV.
status_evidence.claim: Provides the original E325 claim that gives rise to the unresolved tension with the elementary baseline.
